title: PIXEL HUB BAKE BUDGET
why: The first real FASHION picture still showed a vector body. The raid resets the pixel bake budget in gfxpBegin, but the Undercroft never calls that path. A fresh hub and preview could therefore stay vector after the first two builds. The prior preview check hid this by resetting the budget itself.
now: The Undercroft starts each frame with the existing two-build budget, shared with the FASHION turntable. The preview keeps the original soft ground shadow under its nearest 4x body.
